note_ru: An abrupt end — резкий конец. Про человека — грубовато-резкий в общении.
example: The film has an abrupt ending.

examples_extra.en: Sorry if I was abrupt on the phone.
examples_extra.ru: Прости, если я был резок по телефону.

note_ru: Ложный друг! Это не «адекватный человек» (по-английски — sensible, reasonable). Adequate — достаточный, причём часто с оттенком «так себе».
example: The salary is adequate, nothing more.

examples_extra.en: We don't have adequate time for testing.
examples_extra.ru: У нас недостаточно времени на тестирование.

examples_extra.en: The food was adequate but boring.

note_ru: Genuine leather — натуральная кожа, genuine interest — неподдельный интерес. Читается «ДЖЕНьюин».
example: Her surprise was genuine.

examples_extra.en: Is this a genuine antique?

note_ru: Explicit instructions — недвусмысленные инструкции. Пара к implicit (подразумеваемый).
example: She gave explicit instructions.

examples_extra.en: Be explicit about the deadline.

note_ru: Implicit agreement — молчаливое согласие. Противоположность explicit.
example: There was an implicit threat in his words.
example_ru: В его словах была скрытая угроза.

examples_extra.en: Trust was implicit in their deal.
examples_extra.ru: Доверие в их сделке подразумевалось само собой.

note_ru: Наклейка на коробках: FRAGILE. И переносно: a fragile peace — хрупкий мир.
example: Careful, the vase is fragile.

examples_extra.en: The ceasefire remains fragile.

def_en: very deep or strong in effect
note_ru: Глубокая мысль — profound, глубокая яма — deep. A profound effect — глубокое влияние.
example: The book had a profound effect on me.
example_ru: Книга оказала на меня глубокое влияние.

examples_extra.en: She said something surprisingly profound.
examples_extra.ru: Она сказала нечто на удивление глубокое.

def_en: existing in small amounts, hard to find
note_ru: Water is scarce — воды не хватает. Scarcely — едва (как hardly).
example: Affordable flats are scarce here.

examples_extra.en: Jobs were scarce after the crisis.

note_ru: Famous — просто известный, notorious — известный плохим: notorious traffic.
example: The road is notorious for accidents.

examples_extra.en: He's notorious for being late.

def_en: important and well known; easy to see
note_ru: A prominent scientist — видный учёный. In a prominent place — на видном месте.
example: She's a prominent lawyer in the city.

examples_extra.en: Put the warning in a prominent place.

def_en: far away; done from a distance
note_ru: Remote village — глухая деревня, remote work — удалёнка, remote control — пульт.
example: They live in a remote village.

examples_extra.en: Remote work suits me perfectly.

def_en: boring and taking a long time
note_ru: Скучный от монотонности: tedious paperwork. Сильнее и противнее, чем boring.
example: Filling in the forms was tedious.

examples_extra.en: The journey grew tedious after ten hours.
examples_extra.ru: После десяти часов дорога стала утомительной.

def_en: easy to see through; open and honest
note_ru: Transparent pricing — прозрачные цены. Прозрачность процессов — transparency.
example: The company is transparent about salaries.

examples_extra.en: The lid is transparent plastic.

note_ru: An urgent matter — срочное дело. Пометка в письмах: URGENT.
example: It's urgent - call me back now.

examples_extra.en: The roof needs urgent repairs.

note_ru: A vague answer — уклончивый ответ. A vague memory — смутное воспоминание. Читается «вейг».
example: His answer was deliberately vague.

examples_extra.en: I have only a vague idea of the plan.
examples_extra.ru: О плане у меня лишь смутное представление.

def_en: very clear and strong in the mind; bright
note_ru: A vivid memory — яркое воспоминание, vivid imagination — живое воображение.
example: I have a vivid memory of that day.
example_ru: У меня яркое воспоминание о том дне.

examples_extra.en: She paints in vivid colours.

note_ru: Widespread support — широкая поддержка, widespread flooding — масштабные наводнения.
example: The practice is widespread in the industry.
example_ru: Эта практика широко распространена в отрасли.

examples_extra.en: There was widespread confusion about the rules.

note_ru: Compulsory education — обязательное образование. Синоним — mandatory.
example: Helmets are compulsory on site.

examples_extra.en: Attendance is compulsory for first-years.

def_en: done by choice, not because you must
note_ru: Voluntary work — волонтёрство. Противоположность compulsory.
example: The training is voluntary.

examples_extra.en: She does voluntary work at the shelter.

note_ru: A temporary job, a temporary fix. Временный работник — a temp.
example: It's only a temporary solution.

examples_extra.en: The road is closed - temporary measure.

def_en: lasting forever or a very long time
note_ru: A permanent job — постоянная работа, permanent address — постоянный адрес.
example: She's looking for a permanent position.

examples_extra.en: The marker leaves a permanent mark.

note_ru: A gradual improvement — постепенное улучшение. Наречие gradually — постепенно.
example: We saw a gradual improvement.

examples_extra.en: The change was gradual but steady.

note_ru: Initial reaction — первая реакция. Initials — инициалы. Initially — поначалу.
example: My initial reaction was to say no.

examples_extra.en: The initial cost is high, but it pays off.
examples_extra.ru: Начальные затраты высоки, но они окупаются.

note_ru: Frequent flyer — часто летающий пассажир. Наречие frequently = often, но формальнее.
example: Delays are frequent on this line.

examples_extra.en: He's a frequent guest on the show.

note_ru: Rare birds — редкие птицы. В ресторане: rare / medium / well done — прожарка стейка!
example: It's rare to see him angry.

examples_extra.en: Medium rare, please.

note_ru: To be precise — если быть точным. Precise instructions — точные указания.
example: Give me the precise time of arrival.

examples_extra.en: Three weeks - two, to be precise.

def_en: working well without wasting time or energy
note_ru: Efficient — экономно, effective — результативно. Обогреватель efficient (мало ест), лекарство effective (помогает).
example: The new boiler is very efficient.

examples_extra.en: She's the most efficient worker here.

note_ru: Пара к efficient. Effective from Monday — вступает в силу с понедельника.
example: The ad campaign was very effective.

examples_extra.en: The new rules are effective from May.
